commands.name: create-task

commands.name: my-tasks

commands.subtitle: Taskit

commands.name: search-tasks

commands.subtitle: Taskit

commands.name: menu-bar

commands.subtitle: Taskit

tools.name: create-task
tools.title: Create Task
tools.description: Create a task from a sentence. The Taskit API parses dates, priority, and tags, then saves the task. Optional list is a list name or id. Returns the created task.

tools.name: search-tasks
tools.title: Search Tasks
tools.description: Search the user's tasks by text. Does not change anything.

tools.name: list-tasks
tools.title: List Tasks
tools.description: Read open tasks for a smart view (today, inbox, upcoming, overdue, backlog) or for one list. Pass a list name or id to read that list instead of a view. Defaults to today.

tools.name: complete-task
tools.title: Complete Task
tools.description: Mark a task completed. Returns the updated task.

tools.name: update-task
tools.title: Update Task
tools.description: Change a task's title, list, schedule (startAt), deadline (dueAt), or priority. Dates must be ISO-8601 with a timezone offset. Pass an empty string to clear a date. Returns the updated task.

preferences.name: apiBaseUrl
preferences.title: API Base URL
preferences.description: Leave the default. Use http://localhost:7071 only when the API is running on this Mac.
